title: Among cards with the 'legendary' frame effect that are legal in the 'premod
question: Among cards with the 'legendary' frame effect that are legal in the 'premodern' format and have no multiple faces, find the Italian-translated names of those with the highest converted mana cost within each set they belong to.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_072 AS uuid, c.XCL_063 AS set_code, c.XCL_011 AS cmc
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_018 = 'legendary'
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'premodern'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
      AND c.XCL_037 = 'normal'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT e.uuid, e.set_code, e.cmc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.set_code ORDER BY e.cmc DESC) AS rn
    FROM eligible e
)
SELECT fd.XCL_079
FROM ranked r
INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON r.uuid = fd.XCL_082
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_072 AS uuid, c.XCL_063 AS set_code, c.XCL_011 AS cmc
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_018 = 'legendary'
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'premodern'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
      AND c.XCL_037 = 'normal'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT e.uuid, e.set_code, e.cmc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.set_code ORDER BY e.cmc DESC) AS rn
    FROM eligible e
)
SELECT fd.XCL_079
FROM ranked r
INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON r.uuid = fd.XCL_082
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_094"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_093"
WHERE T1."XCL_018" = 'legendary'
  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'premodern'
  AND T1."XCL_016" IS NULL
  AND T3."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
  AND T1."XCL_011" = (
      SELECT MAX(T1_sub."XCL_011")
      FROM cards AS T1_sub
      INNER JOIN legalities AS T2_sub ON T1_sub."XCL_072" = T2_sub."XCL_086"
      INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3_sub ON T1_sub."XCL_063" = T3_sub."XCL_093"
      WHERE T1_sub."XCL_018" = 'legendary'
        AND T2_sub."XCL_084" = 'premodern'
        AND T1_sub."XCL_016" IS NULL
        AND T3_sub."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
        AND T1_sub."XCL_063" = T1."XCL_063"
  )
